meta.title: Why the app sometimes tells you to change nothing
meta.status: DRAFT — not publish-ready until compliance-reviewer PASS is on record

slides.heading: Why the app sometimes tells you to change nothing.
slides.supporting: A hold is a decision, not a shrug.

slides.heading: Not every week carries a real signal.
slides.supporting: Some weeks are mostly noise, and noise is not a reason to act.

slides.heading: Changing on noise makes progress harder to read.
slides.supporting: Move too often and you can never tell what the last change did.

slides.heading: When the data is thin, the app waits.
slides.supporting: It needs enough observations before it will act, and it will not guess.

slides.heading: Patience is the honest answer here.
slides.supporting: Holding this week is often what keeps next week readable.

slides.heading: Same inputs, same decision, every week explained.
slides.supporting: Volyume tells you when to hold and why, not just when to push.
